basic_info.description: Elegantly perched on the corner of a quintessential block in the heart of Cow Hollow, this top floor, two bed two bath Edwardian condo is a timeless blend of classic period details and meticulous renovation. A gracious foyer is the center point of a home with excellent flow, spacious rooms, and high curved ceilings. All-day light spills in from the skylight and wide windows, with south exposure and charming outlooks. Impeccable thought and detail was put into the remodel: a proper primary suite includes an ensuite bath, built-in closets, and W/D. The custom kitchen with herringbone tile, high-end appliances, wine fridge and built-ins was designed to maximize storage, aesthetic, and little luxuries. Downstairs is a verdant shared backyard, complete with BBQ and seating, and a private storage room that doubled as an office during the pandemic. This boutique, 4-unit building offers a large private garage to each owner. Green Street is a magical tree-lined block with wide streets and sidewalks, friendly neighbors, and incredible walkability. Enjoy the ideal San Francisco lifestyle in this vibrant and well-loved neighborhood, from Roaming Goat wine bar and Perry's Restaurant to Wrecking Ball coffee and Epicurean Trader, the list of shops and restaurants is endless. Best of the city!
